item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03070","case1_error":"Correct deposit formulas are followed by unsupported final numbers; the formulas yield $1,110.","case2_error":"Correct percentage formula is followed by unsupported 40.0; it yields 20%.","reason":"Both give unsupported final numbers after correct formulas, without showing the calculation producing those numbers.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J03071","case1_error":"Incorrectly reduces 36 × 9 × 12 to 432 × 12; 36 × 9 is 324.","case2_error":"Omits the additional 10 pages used for math, reporting the intermediate remainder of 90 instead of 80.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correctly written expression; the second omits a required subtraction.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03072","case1_error":"Uses doubled two-week vegetable consumption as a weekly amount before adding weekly kale.","case2_error":"Counts only three meals, omitting Bret from the four people ordering dinner.","reason":"The first mixes time periods; the second undercounts participants by excluding the named person.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03073","case1_error":"Treats each two-dozen set as 12 cups, omitting the factor of two.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported 63 after correctly specifying total plates and the subtraction formula; the correct result is 35.","reason":"The first explicitly misrepresents set size; the second supplies an unexplained incorrect number after correct formulas.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03074","case1_error":"Incorrectly reduces 36 × 9 × 12 to 432 × 12; 36 × 9 is 324.","case2_error":"Divides total area by six as though rooms were equal; five ordinary rooms plus the living room represent eight equal units.","reason":"The first makes a numerical evaluation error; the second uses an erroneous area-allocation relation.","judgment":"different"}]}
